parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is trying to deflect the pressure by claiming she is stuck. She received wood from that 4, which helps her build towards node 23. Ziv is right to be worried—she only needs one settlement to win. I need to keep the table focused on her as the primary threat, especially since I don't have any brick (טיט) to offer anyway. My goal is to prevent anyone from trading her the winning resource while I try to build my own settlement at 18.
